name: AH-LAM SHENG
note: AH-LAM SHENG (doc 04: 'Laundry; and, in practice, the bank'), at his ironing board ('He is ironing', doc 54). No document describes his looks; he is drawn as room-28's composition master drew him, then on magenta against Thad with his board, shirt and iron (room-28 operation 3), cut by tools/art/room28-sheng.py. His tree opens SHE_A1, and SHE_D1 while its business is open (errata 99 D).
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HIM: on the floor before the mangle, clear of the board, facing him.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for Sheng.

sprite.levelManNote: ERRATA 235: the man its sheet was snapped to one level at (errata 112 G), kept while it is drawn at its new height without a re-snap; the drift is held to 5% (tests/one-level.test.mjs).
sprite.frameNote: 0 ironing · 1 breath (derived) · 2 a look up · 3 the stroke · 4 the return · 5 the iron to his cheek, testing its heat · 6 folding, the iron on its heel · 7 a dry point, his talk frame. Breathing on 0 and 1; every `breakEvery` seconds one break -- strokes, a look, the heat, the fold (errata 77).
